up: List the molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727451. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL molecule identifier (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Use the docs table to find the document by chembl_id, then join through compound_records (on doc_id) to molecule_dictionary (on molregno) and compound_structures (on molregno). Do not add any extra filters.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727451';
